visual_intent.reason: Strict Apple fidelity is the default visual contract.

target.platform_or_web_analogy: Windows Tauri desktop web app with macOS productivity analogy
form_factors: expanded desktop window with dense data tables
compact desktop window with stacked summaries and horizontally scrollable tables
platform_adaptations: Keep Windows/Tauri window behavior and existing Vue routing; use macOS productivity only for density, toolbar anatomy, materials, focus, and keyboard interaction.
Use native HTML selects for modest value lists so Windows and assistive technology retain familiar selection behavior.
Preserve all committed filters and the active workspace while the layout changes size class.

primary_user_outcome: Make economics and account-health history truthful at every time scale, expose bounded health inspection, and keep the desktop shell coherent
essential_content_hierarchy: Global freshness and source-health summary: users first see whether each source is measured, estimated, stale, unavailable, or genuinely zero.
Time semantics: natural day, rolling window, lifetime cumulative, and retained history are labeled before numeric comparison.

Adaptive operational metrics and charts: 5-second to 6-hour buckets target 30-120 points; only valid finite values render as money, counts, or latency and unavailable values render a reason and retry path.
Account, model, and route evidence tables: each row exposes measured, fallback, estimated, or missing provenance.
Data governance workspace: source inventory, retention policy, history coverage, immutable-ledger boundary, and safe maintenance actions.

product_expression.rationale: The console manages money and account availability. Visual polish must reduce ambiguity and increase confidence, never make estimates look more authoritative.

media_evidence.reason: The HIG Materials composition and WWDC25 interaction sequence directly inform separation of the data content plane from the floating functional toolbar.

evidence_decisions.observation: Apple describes Liquid Glass as a distinct functional layer for navigation and controls, while content surfaces such as tables and data panels remain standard or opaque; status and accessibility guidance requires meaning beyond color alone.
evidence_decisions.communicative_purpose: Protect legibility and make control hierarchy predictable above information-dense content.
evidence_decisions.product_decision: Apply one Regular functional material scope to the sticky console toolbar and transient governance dialog only; keep metrics, charts, tables, and history records opaque.
evidence_decisions.condition_changes: At compact widths the toolbar stacks and horizontally scrolls destinations, but the active workspace and filters remain unchanged.
evidence_decisions.accessibility_adaptation: Reduced transparency and no-backdrop modes use an opaque toolbar; increased contrast and forced colors retain borders, focus, labels, icons, and status text.

evidence_decisions.observation: A 740×416 construction drawing shows a capsule overlapping a square; bent square edges communicate that the upper functional surface affects but does not replace background content.

media_analysis.canvas: Wide 740×416 landscape teaching illustration with a centered construction diagram.
media_analysis.composition: One capsule crosses a square on a visible grid; overlap is the focal relationship and yellow line art remains restrained.
focal_points: bent background edges beneath the capsule
media_analysis.crop_behavior: The relationship, not any protected artwork, transfers to the product; compact layouts retain a complete toolbar above complete content rather than cropping either layer.
media_analysis.negative_space: Open space around the overlap keeps the cause-and-effect relationship readable.
media_analysis.purpose: Teach functional-layer separation, geometry, and visible causality.

evidence_decisions.communicative_purpose: Users can distinguish controls that change the view from the data that is being inspected.
evidence_decisions.product_decision: Keep the toolbar visually floating over a quiet content field; use explicit source badges and boundaries instead of applying glass to every metric card.
evidence_decisions.condition_changes: Expanded windows use one continuous toolbar; compact windows stack its groups without nesting material surfaces.
evidence_decisions.accessibility_adaptation: The hierarchy remains intact when blur, grid decoration, and accent color are removed.

evidence_decisions.observation: Sparse keyframes show input-local contact feedback, content moving beneath one floating control plane, controls adapting to background, and menus preserving their triggering origin.

media_analysis.time_range: WWDC25 session 219, Dynamics 1:29–6:00 and Principles 10:31–18:53; sparse keyframes at 220s, 300s, and 400s.
media_analysis.initial_state: A quiet control plane sits above legible content.
media_analysis.transition: Pointer or touch contact produces local light and restrained scale while scroll state activates one contextual edge.
media_analysis.interruption: Presentation feedback begins from the current rendered state and can be reversed without blocking product input.
media_analysis.completion: The chosen workspace or maintenance action is visibly and semantically committed, with focus retained or returned.
media_analysis.input_feedback: Feedback originates at the actual control, while labels, focus rings, pressed state, and live status provide redundant cues.
media_analysis.reduced_motion: Remove spatial flex and lens travel; keep a short opacity/color acknowledgement and immediate semantic state update.

evidence_decisions.communicative_purpose: Immediate causal feedback confirms which control changed the operational view without distracting from live data.
evidence_decisions.product_decision: Use the compiled presentation runtime for toolbar press and pointer-local light; data refresh and selection remain Vue product state, and destructive sample reset uses an anchored confirmation dialog.
evidence_decisions.condition_changes: Pointer feedback is enabled on desktop; keyboard focus remains first-class; reduced-motion and touch paths do not depend on hover.
evidence_decisions.accessibility_adaptation: Focus-visible, aria-current/aria-selected, status text, and confirmation copy carry the same meaning without animation.

evidence_decisions.observation: A trustworthy economics console needs a coherent desktop toolbar, an opaque data plane, explicit provenance states, and reversible presentation feedback.
evidence_decisions.communicative_purpose: Make money, health, and history decisions scannable without turning missing data into convincing-looking zeros.
evidence_decisions.product_decision: Compile macos-productivity with the existing Sub2API operational lime accent, add a reusable DataValue state model, introduce a data-governance workspace, and prohibit generic numeric formatters from coercing null or non-finite values to zero.
evidence_decisions.condition_changes: Dense tables scroll on compact windows; summary grids reflow; source truth and active filters persist across all size classes.
evidence_decisions.accessibility_adaptation: Every data state includes text and icon semantics, tables retain reading order, dialogs return focus, and preference fallbacks remove blur/motion without hiding controls.

information_architecture.navigation_model: One persistent desktop toolbar exposes five peer workspaces: asset overview, upstream ranking, channel pool, data governance, and API access. A separately styled Sub2API Settings action leaves the monitoring workspace without pretending to be a sixth selected peer. Route query state preserves the active destination.
component_anatomy: Windows desktop titlebar: app identity, drag region, minimize, maximize/restore, and close using native Windows semantics above the product toolbar.
Functional toolbar: brand/version, workspace destination group, explicit Sub2API Settings destination, time-window value selector, refresh-period value selector, refresh and fullscreen actions.
Truth status strip: source name, measured/estimated/stale/unavailable state, last success time, and failure reason.
Truthful metric: label, optional finite value, unit, provenance badge, time scope, empty/error explanation, and optional recovery action.
Opaque data sections: metric grids, adaptive charts with at most three visible series, explicit partial/no-data overlays and event markers, plus account/model/route tables with row-level provenance.
Data governance workspace: source inventory, time semantics, history coverage, retention policy, immutable-ledger notice, and confirmed maintenance actions.
Confirmation dialog: exact derived-data target, consequence, cancel, and primary confirm; billing ledgers cannot be deleted from this surface.
information_architecture.location_action_destination: The active toolbar destination is labeled and selected; each workspace heading describes its scope; maintenance actions sit next to the history source they affect and explain the post-action state.

selection_controls.user_intent: choose one persistent observation range, refresh interval, ranking metric, model grouping, or audit filter from a short static list
selection_controls.options_shape: two to nine static mutually exclusive values with short labels
selection_controls.why_this_pattern: The choices need no preview, rich rows, search, or nested actions; native Windows and assistive behavior is a product benefit.
selection_controls.why_native_select: Retains reliable keyboard, zoom, touch, and screen-reader behavior in the Tauri WebView while exposing the current value.
selection_controls.expanded_adaptation: compact native-select inside the functional toolbar or local filter group
selection_controls.keyboard_and_focus: Platform-native open, arrow navigation, commit, and focus behavior.
selection_controls.dismissal_and_persistence: A committed change updates Vue state and reloads the exact requested window; cancel leaves the prior value.
selection_controls.accessibility_state: Visible label is associated with the select and the committed option remains exposed.

verification_probes.expected_visible: The label and data time scope update to the committed value
verification_probes.expected_semantic: The select value and dependent headings match

verification_probes.action: Focus the select and change value with the keyboard
verification_probes.expected_visible: The selected value and data scope update once
verification_probes.expected_semantic: A native change event commits one value

verification_probes.action: Use the control in the Windows WebView and browser fallback
verification_probes.expected_visible: The native popup remains legible and current value visible
verification_probes.expected_semantic: The control remains a labeled native select

selection_controls.user_intent: switch among a small visible set of peer workspaces or account-platform views
selection_controls.options_shape: three to five visible mutually exclusive destinations or modes
selection_controls.why_this_pattern: The alternatives and current selection must remain glanceable in a desktop operations console.
selection_controls.why_not_native_select: Hiding peer destinations would weaken wayfinding and slow repeated monitoring.
selection_controls.compact_adaptation: horizontally scrollable labeled segment group without truncating the selected item
selection_controls.expanded_adaptation: persistent toolbar or local segmented group
selection_controls.keyboard_and_focus: Tab enters the group; arrow keys move the active choice; activation updates aria-current or aria-selected.
selection_controls.dismissal_and_persistence: Selection persists in route or local product state and does not use a transient popup.
selection_controls.accessibility_state: Group label, selected state, visible text, and non-color indicator.

verification_probes.expected_visible: Exactly one segment and its content are selected
verification_probes.expected_semantic: aria-current or aria-selected moves to the committed segment
verification_probes.expected_focus: Focus remains on the activated segment

verification_probes.action: Navigate the visible choices by keyboard
verification_probes.expected_visible: The intended choice becomes selected without hiding labels
verification_probes.expected_semantic: The group exposes one selected item

verification_probes.action: Inspect with color removed or forced colors
verification_probes.expected_visible: Selection remains identifiable by shape, text weight, and indicator
verification_probes.expected_focus: The selected control stays keyboard reachable

selection_controls.user_intent: choose one account whose retained model-cost history should be inspected
selection_controls.options_shape: dynamic account list with one aggregate option; desktop users primarily select by account name
selection_controls.why_this_pattern: This change preserves the existing stable control while truthful data-state work is completed; account search remains available in the upstream workspace.
selection_controls.why_native_select: The current Tauri WebView supplies typeahead and a scrollable system list without introducing an unverified custom combobox.
selection_controls.expanded_adaptation: labeled native select with enough inline width for account identity
selection_controls.keyboard_and_focus: Native typeahead, arrows, commit, and focus behavior.
selection_controls.dismissal_and_persistence: Commit reloads the exact model window; cancellation preserves the previous account.
selection_controls.accessibility_state: Visible label and selected account name; deleted accounts remain represented only through retained-history labels, not fabricated live rows.

verification_probes.expected_visible: The heading and model rows show the selected account scope
verification_probes.expected_semantic: The select value and data query scope match

verification_probes.expected_visible: A named account can be selected

verification_probes.action: Open the account list in the Windows WebView
verification_probes.expected_visible: Long account labels remain inspectable and the selected value is visible
verification_probes.expected_semantic: The control remains a native labeled select
verification_probes.expected_focus: The platform restores focus after closing

selection_controls.user_intent: enter bounded history, expiry, and audit date-time values with the platform picker
selection_controls.options_shape: calendar dates and local date-time values constrained by each form's minimum and maximum
selection_controls.why_this_pattern: These controls collect literal temporal values rather than choosing actions or navigating destinations; the Windows WebView picker supplies familiar calendar, keyboard, locale, and touch behavior.
selection_controls.why_native_picker: The value is a literal date or local date-time and does not require rich results, search, actions, or custom preview; using the WebView's native picker preserves locale, validation, keyboard, and touch conventions.
selection_controls.compact_adaptation: full-width labeled native date or datetime-local input
selection_controls.expanded_adaptation: labeled native date or datetime-local field aligned with the related form values
selection_controls.keyboard_and_focus: Platform-native typing, picker invocation, validation, commit, and focus behavior.
selection_controls.dismissal_and_persistence: Closing without commit preserves the prior form value; submitting the parent form persists the validated temporal value.
selection_controls.accessibility_state: Every temporal input keeps a visible associated label, native value semantics, validation text, and disabled or required state.

verification_probes.action: Choose a valid date or local date-time
verification_probes.expected_visible: The committed localized value remains visible
verification_probes.expected_semantic: The native input value matches the form state
verification_probes.expected_focus: Focus returns to or remains on the input

verification_probes.action: Enter and adjust the value with the keyboard
verification_probes.expected_visible: The date parts update without hiding validation
verification_probes.expected_semantic: The native input exposes the updated value

verification_probes.action: Enter a value outside the permitted boundary
verification_probes.expected_visible: The form exposes a specific validation message
verification_probes.expected_semantic: The invalid state is announced and submission is blocked
verification_probes.expected_focus: Focus can return to the invalid field

visual_direction.typography: Use the compiled system stack with compact desktop text roles: tight display headings, readable body leading, tabular/monospaced numerals for money and diagnostics, and wrapping for status explanations.
visual_direction.color: Retain the product-owned Sub2API operational lime as selection and primary-action accent; separate success, warning, danger, information, labels, surfaces, and focus into semantic roles.

color_system.source: existing Sub2API Cost Console operational lime and dark instrumentation identity
color_system.source_evidence: The current product consistently uses #B9E55A for selected navigation and primary refresh actions; the graph-paper field is an established economics-console identity rather than a generic AI palette.
role_map: label-primary: essential money, status, and headings
action/selection: Sub2API lime, reserved for active destination and one primary action
success/warning/danger/info: independent operational states paired with icon and text
focus-ring: high-contrast light-lime boundary distinct from selected fill
material-regular: neutral adaptive toolbar material with opaque fallback

appearance_matrix.light: Compiled profile supplies light roles; data states preserve labels and non-color cues.
appearance_matrix.dark: Primary shipped appearance uses deep neutral surfaces, restrained lime selection, readable white labels, and stronger separators around dense tables.
appearance_matrix.increased_contrast: Strengthen boundaries, focus, text separation, and chart patterns without changing state meanings.
appearance_matrix.reduced_transparency: Toolbar and dialogs become opaque neutral surfaces with explicit borders.
appearance_matrix.forced_colors: Use system Canvas, CanvasText, Highlight, ButtonText, and visible outlines; icons and state labels remain present.

color_system.accent_distribution: Accent foreground marks ordinary selection; accent background is limited to the active workspace and the one primary maintenance/refresh action in a group; status colors never reuse accent semantics.
measured_pairs: not-tested during briefing; final runtime verification must measure primary/secondary text, accent controls, focus, warnings, and error states on actual dark and light surfaces
color_system.gradient_rationale: The existing subtle orthogonal grid is retained only on the canvas as product-owned instrumentation context; chart series and status never depend on decorative gradients, and functional material gradients come only from the compiled profile.

visual_direction.geometry: Use compact fixed-radius desktop controls, stable opaque section containers, and concentric toolbar/dialog geometry; capsules are reserved for visible segments, status badges, and prominent actions.
visual_direction.material: One Regular functional material scope covers the sticky toolbar; data cards, charts, tables, and governance records remain opaque. Reduced transparency, increased contrast, forced colors, and no-backdrop use explicit opaque boundaries.

imagery.purpose: No decorative product imagery is introduced; live data and provenance are the focal content. HIG imagery informs layer relationships only.
focal_points: history source and consequence of each action
imagery.crop_behavior: No bitmap crop; compact layouts reflow complete semantic groups and preserve table access through labeled horizontal scrolling.
viewport_adaptations: compact stacked summaries and scrollable tables

motion.purpose: Confirm causal control interaction and source refresh without animating money values or implying data that has not arrived.
state_transitions: press feedback begins immediately at the toolbar control and is interruptible
workspace change preserves route state and uses restrained content cross-fade
source refresh shows loading then measured/empty/error result without zero interpolation
history confirmation opens from its action region and returns focus after cancel or completion
motion.reduced_motion_adaptation: Disable lens travel, scale, and spatial transition; retain immediate semantic updates and a short opacity/color acknowledgement.

accessibility.semantic_structure: Landmarks, one page heading, labeled workspace navigation, real buttons/selects, table headers, status regions, and modal dialog semantics describe the interface without styling.
accessibility.input_equivalence: Every action is keyboard and pointer reachable; native selects preserve platform input; workspace groups expose selection; dialogs support Escape, Cancel, confirmation, and focus return.
accessibility.large_text_and_localization: Use rem-based typography, wrap status and provenance text, stack control groups and metric grids, and never truncate the only words that distinguish a data state.
accessibility.contrast_and_non_color_cues: State color is always paired with icon, label, badge text, selected geometry, or border; visible focus and forced-color outlines remain.
accessibility.reduced_transparency_adaptation: Compiled opaque fallback replaces toolbar/dialog blur while preserving layer position, separation, focus, and status hierarchy.

items.decision: Keep the established Windows/Tauri dark graph-paper product identity instead of adding fake macOS window chrome.
items.reason: The macOS productivity profile governs hierarchy, density, toolbar anatomy, focus, and motion; imitating platform chrome would reduce familiarity on Windows and obscure the product's own identity.

items.decision: Retain the native account select during this release instead of introducing a custom searchable combobox.
items.reason: A custom composite needs focused keyboard, touch, screen-reader, dismissal, and runtime verification; truthful data states and history governance are the higher-priority user outcome for this release.

anti_pattern_risks.risk: Applying translucent material to every metric card
anti_pattern_risks.mitigation: Restrict compiled Regular material to the toolbar and transient dialog; keep the data plane opaque.

anti_pattern_risks.risk: Using formatted zero for missing or failed data
anti_pattern_risks.mitigation: Introduce explicit source and value states; numeric formatters accept only finite available values.

anti_pattern_risks.risk: Using lime for action, health, warning, and decoration at once
anti_pattern_risks.mitigation: Separate selection/action accent from operational success, warning, danger, and information roles.

anti_pattern_risks.risk: A history reset button implies billing data deletion
anti_pattern_risks.mitigation: Name the exact derived economics-sample target, keep usage and loss ledgers immutable from this panel, and require explicit confirmation.

anti_pattern_risks.risk: Responsive design merely shrinks the dense canvas
anti_pattern_risks.mitigation: Reflow summaries and toolbar groups while preserving scrollable evidence tables, selection, and source state.
